name: Holiday Feast
body:
Station and Complexity line cook 6, roundsman 6

Flavor Profiles umami, temperature, bitter, salty, texture, sweet
Additional Ingredients any

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1/level
Saving Throw Will negates

DESCRIPTION

A holiday feast is an incredibly large meal wherein many various dishes are prepared, served, and sampled to the point of exhaustion. To make it requires at least 6 lbs. of poultry, allspice, butter, breadcrumbs, carrots, celery, cinnamon, cloves, cranberries, eggs, garlic, ginger, mustard, nutmeg, onion, pork, pepper, potatoes, maple syrup, molasses, salt, and squash.

When consumed, it puts the target to sleep, as with a non-magical cloak of dreams effect.

Additional ingredients each grant the effect of another meal with that flavor profile and a complexity of 2 or lower of the culinarian’s choice, to a maximum of 1 meal per 4 culinarian levels. Meals created in this way have no additional ingredients of their own and are consumed or served separate from the holiday feast.
